bootstrap.unit: paired samples within each dataset; wheel measurements remain together
bootstrap.limitations: Conditional on this one generation/extraction realization; no multiple-testing adjustment; no judge or generation-seed uncertainty included

metric_limits.MER2023: Official wheel-specific GT filtering; M denominator restricted to dataset candidate set
metric_limits.SIMS: 69 zero-valued GT samples excluded; 388 scored; neutral/mixed/unknown predictions map to 0 and count as nonpositive
metric_limits.OV: For each wheel average P/R over valid samples then harmonic F; average across 5 wheels. Diagnostic per-sample F is not the official F.

matched_k_limit: Extracted-label order is not calibrated confidence; post-hoc diagnostic only, not a new evaluation protocol or prompt-selection rule.
